verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API, webhooks and an MCP server that external agents can call. These are developer building blocks for building automations elsewhere, not a Deel feature for setting up autonomous background automations. The marketing phrase "automated compliance" is an adjacent built-in behavior, not user-configured automations, and there is no evidence of a workflow builder, scheduled jobs or background agent runs inside Deel.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
